# Vendored docker-guard

Unmodified runtime, package metadata, and Apache-2.0 license from
[`git-stunts/docker-guard`](https://github.com/git-stunts/docker-guard/tree/aa086b41b5312765ffb5df7355d6af1a58cf3df0),
commit `aa086b41b5312765ffb5df7355d6af1a58cf3df0` (package version 0.1.0).

The local `scripts/require-docker.mjs` adapter supplies verified container
evidence to `ensureDocker`. Vendoring allows raw invocations to fail closed
without a host package installation or network access.
